office_does: The Sheriff runs the Cowlitz County Sheriff's Office, which patrols unincorporated Cowlitz County, investigates crimes and serves civil process.
race_blurb: Uncontested open seat: Undersheriff Troy Brightbill (prefers Republican) is the only candidate after Sheriff Brad Thurman chose not to run again.

candidates.summary: Cowlitz County Undersheriff (prefers Republican) with 27 years in the Sheriff's Office, running unopposed to succeed retiring Sheriff Brad Thurman.
highlights: 27 years with the Sheriff's Office: deputy, sergeant, chief criminal deputy and undersheriff [S1][S2]
Commander of the Lower Columbia Major Crimes Team and assistant commander of Lower Columbia SWAT [S1]
Plans to develop the next generation of law enforcement leaders and give deputies training, tools and support [S1][S2]
